Opebi Link Bridge inward and outward traffic is flowing well at Walfare Junction.
Opebi Road from Shareton Link Bridge inward to Salvation is good traffic flow.
Congested traffic on Opebi Road from Salvation to Opebi Roundabout and Toyin.
Smooth traffic flow from Allen Intersection back to Toyin, Opebi Roundabout, and down to Shareton Link Bridge.

[6:16PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Significant traffic congestion at Oyebanji Roundabout route connecting Adeniji Adele Road via Oba's Palace and Police Post, resulting from ongoing construction activities.
Heavy traffic volume at Tinubu Square, extending to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street en route Tom Jones Intersection, due to the influx of commuters during the evening rush hour.
Slow traffic movement beneath Idumota Bridge, specifically on the inward journey to Eyin Eyo and connecting to Balogun and Martins Streets, attributed to market activities and frequent bus stops in the area.
Fluid traffic flow observed on Illubinrin ascending Carter Bridge, with a smooth inward journey to Ijora Olopa, as well as on the Oyingbo route.

#FollowLASTMA
